text.autoconfig.arrowaccuracy.title: ArrowAccuracy Config
text.autoconfig.arrowaccuracy.option.stu: Ticks an arrow stays stuck in an entity (1-72000)
text.autoconfig.arrowaccuracy.option.fad: Ticks at the end of the stuck duration the arrow spends fading out, 0 disables fading (0-72000)
text.autoconfig.arrowaccuracy.option.max: Maximum amount of arrows rendered in a single entity, oldest arrows are removed first
text.autoconfig.arrowaccuracy.option.hit: Ticks a stuck arrow waits for the server to confirm the hit by removing the arrow entity
Raise if high ping causes stuck arrows to vanish
text.autoconfig.arrowaccuracy.option.hid: Hides the vanilla randomly placed arrows rendered in players
